Senses.Note: The metal modifiers describe the imagined eyes, while the corpus repeatedly predicates their failure rather than a literal organ.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸佛非我道，鐵眼銅睛覰不破。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Dharma Grove of the Tradition’s Mirror (宗鑑法林). Speaker: Mi'an Xianjie.

Occurrences.Kwic: 藏頭白，海頭黑，鐵眼銅睛皆罔測。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X64/X64n1260.xml). Outline Record of the Successive Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄). Speaker: Guxue Zhenzhe.

Occurrences.Kwic: 到這裏，任是鐵眼銅睛，也須百雜碎。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 34–120) (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Speaker: Shangfang Riyi.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: Shangfang Riyi: The inline Anji Shangfang Riyi section precedes the opening assembly, and the master-said marker governs the headword warning.

Occurrences.Kwic: 銀山鐵壁勢崔嵬，鐵眼銅睛覷不及。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J28/J28nB212.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Eryin Mi (二隱謐禪師語錄). Speaker: Eryin Mi.

Occurrences.Kwic: 第一座鐵眼銅睛󳬇不破，第二座陽春白雪無人和，第三座真實身心同達磨。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1296.xml). Compilation of the School Gate’s “Raising Old Cases” (宗門拈古彙集). Speaker: Tiantong Hua.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: Tiantong Hua: The explicit Tiantong Hua-said marker assigns the numbered-seat appraisal and its iron-eye clause to Hua.

Occurrences.Kwic: 遂橫按拄杖云：有時橫按孤峯頂，鐵眼銅睛不敢窺。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X68/X68n1318.xml). Continued Essentials from the Sayings of Ancient Worthies (續古尊宿語要). Speaker: Miaozhan Hui.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: Miaozhan Hui: The surrounding address is explicitly under Miaozhan Hui, and the staff-raising marker remains inside Hui's speech when the headword is predicated of eyes that dare not look.

Senses.Explanation: Iron eyes with bronze pupils are the corpus's image of exceptionally hard, penetrating sight, yet each retained use stresses what even such eyes cannot see, measure, or withstand. Mi'an Xianjie says such eyes cannot see through the patriarchal saying, Guxue Zhenzhe says they cannot measure Mazu's displayed activity, and an Anji master says they still shatter before the matter raised at his opening assembly.
